headline: EPS swings to a profit sequentially but falls year-over-year
summary_short: Sawai Group Holdings reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥21.04, swinging from a ¥2.70 per-share loss last quarter but down 50.3% y/y from ¥42.36.
summary_long: EPS of ¥21.04 marks a swing to a profit from a ¥2.70 per-share loss in the prior quarter, but is down 50.3% year-over-year from ¥42.36. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
